summary.text: Jim Pillen is the Republican governor of Nebraska, a veterinarian and livestock producer who served on the University of Nebraska Board of Regents before winning the governorship in 2022 with 59.2% of the vote. His office has pursued property-tax changes, and he signed a 12-week abortion limit and a law (LB 574) in 2023 that also restricts gender-altering procedures for people under 19.

paragraphs.text: B.S. in animal science from the University of Nebraska–Lincoln and D.V.M. from Kansas State University; played defensive back for Nebraska football (1975–1978).
Practicing veterinarian and chair of Pillen Family Farms.
Served on the University of Nebraska Board of Regents from 2013 to 2023, including as chair in 2020; elected governor in 2022.
